8.3.6 DoIP_Init
[SWS_DoIP_00026] Definition of API function DoIP_Init
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00024
⌈
Service Name
DoIP_Init
Syntax
void DoIP_Init (
const DoIP_ConfigType* DoIPConfigPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x01
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
DoIPConfigPtr
Pointer to the configuration data of the DoIP module
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This service initializes all global variables of the DoIP module. After return of this service the Do
IP module is operational.
Available via
DoIP.h
⌋
